name: ragRetrievalLive
description: Retrieval from a local index (rag/localIndex.js, exact squared L2) with cached Cohere query vectors. No provider was called and nothing was written.

config.distanceNote: Squared L2 over the stored float32 vectors, computed locally (Chroma's default l2 space); lower = closer; ties broken by index order.

relevanceRule: Answerable: relevant iff filename matches the a-priori expected-file pattern AND chunk text contains each required term group (district, and crop where stated). Advisory: answer-bearing is impossible by construction (no advisory text ingested); 'topical' = chunk text contains the topic term group. Labels are author-defined and mechanical; not human-judged.

rowTextOnly.rule: Same frozen rule, applied to the chunk text without its File:/Table:/Columns:/Headers:/Data: lines, so a term counts only when it occurs in row text. Header names repeated inside 'header: value' pairs still count.
